title: Concept: SHA-1 use via Digest::SHA1.hexdigest (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, Digest::SHA1.hexdigest computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The ruby-specific remedy is Digest::SHA256.hexdigest.
applicability: ruby codebases hashing data through Digest::SHA1.hexdigest; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
